files.README.md:
# units

Temperature conversions on the command line.

## c2f

    node bin/units.js c2f 100    # prints 212

issue.title: units: add an f2c command for Fahrenheit to Celsius
issue.problem: bin/units.js only knows c2f. Any other command prints `unknown command` and exits 2, so there is no way to convert Fahrenheit to Celsius from the command line. src/convert.js exports only cToF.
issue.reason: Weather data we import arrives in Fahrenheit and we convert it by hand before every report.
issue.outcome: `node bin/units.js f2c <degrees>` prints the Celsius value, and c2f behaves exactly as it does today.
expect: `node bin/units.js f2c 212` prints `100` followed by a newline.
`node bin/units.js f2c 98.6` prints `37` followed by a newline.
`node bin/units.js c2f 100` still prints `212` followed by a newline.
`npm test` exits 0, and test/ contains at least one test of the Fahrenheit to Celsius conversion.
README.md documents f2c with an example invocation.
